q: What is the recommended fertilizer schedule for transplanted rice?
answer: For transplanted rice, apply N and K as 25% each at 21 DAS, at active tillering, PI and heading stages.

q: How to control sheath blight in rice?
answer: Control sheath blight in rice by seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg of seed followed by seedling dip @ 2.5 kg/ha dissolved in 100 litres and dipping for 30 minutes. Soil application of P.fluorescens @ 2.5 kg/ha after 30 days of transplanting.
